content.text: In Nigeria, Kenya, and other regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face a critical infrastructure gap: how to sell ebooks, courses, and templates without relying on platforms that reject them. GitHub Pages offers a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-5|sovereign]] solution—free, globally accessible hosting for your digital product store. This post breaks down the architecture, from crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-works-how|How Payment]] processing to automated file delivery, so you can own your stack instead of renting it.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free static site hosting service that serves your digital product store directly from a GitHub repository. Paired with Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, it becomes a fully operational commerce stack. Unlike Gumroad or Payhip, which charge 10% per sale, NOWPayments takes only 0.5%. At 100 sales of a $97 product monthly, you retain $921 more. This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform fees. No access revocation. No geographic restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend of your store is built with HTML/CSS/JS and hosted on GitHub Pages. Cloudflare Workers handle backend tasks like order processing and file delivery. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain and triggers delivery via webhook. Orders are logged in a Google Sheet or Supabase database. Product files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system is stateless: no servers to manage, no databases to maintain. Every component is free or low-cost, and the entire stack deploys in under 48 hours. The customer pays in USDT, BTC, or any of 300+ cryptocurrencies, and the system automatically converts the price to USD at transaction time.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are blocked or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or software and cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, this architecture gives you sovereignty. It’s also for creators who refuse to pay 10% platform fees or be locked into proprietary systems. The stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are realities. It’s not just an alternative—it’s better architecture. You own the infrastructure. The customer owns their purchase. No middlemen. No rent.
GitHub Pages hosting is free and globally accessible—no platform fees, no geographic blocks.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages hosts the store frontend. Cloudflare Workers execute backend logic, like verifying payments and triggering file downloads. NOWPayments handles crypto transactions with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Google Sheets or Supabase stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers product files. Each component is modular and replaceable. For example, switch from Google Sheets to Supabase for scalability, or from GitHub Pages to Cloudflare Pages for edge performance. The stack is designed for sovereignty, not convenience. You control every layer. The customer interacts directly with your infrastructure, not a third-party platform.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by forking the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack template on GitHub. Customize the HTML/CSS to match your brand. Connect NOWPayments to your crypto wallet and configure the webhook URL. Deploy the Cloudflare Worker script to handle payment verification and file delivery. Test the entire flow end-to-end with a small transaction. Once verified, push your changes to GitHub Pages. Your store is live. For advanced configurations, like SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup or multi-product catalogs, refer to the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Deploy today. Own tomorrow.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a GitHub Pages store with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Host the ebook files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Use Cloudflare Workers to verify payments and trigger downloads. Log orders in a Google Sheet or Supabase. This stack costs nothing to host and processes payments with a 0.5% fee. It’s sovereign infrastructure—no platform dependence, no geographic restrictions. The customer pays in crypto, and the system delivers the ebook automatically. You own the entire process.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, retaining $921 more than Gumroad at 100 sales of a $97 product.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or digital downloads with crypto-only payments, the architecture outlined here scales seamlessly. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for every stack COREMERCH offers. It’s everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Stop renting platforms. Start owning infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Fork the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack template from GitHub. Customize the HTML/CSS for your brand. Connect your crypto wallet to NOWPayments and configure the webhook. Write the Cloudflare Worker script to handle payment verification and file delivery. Test the entire flow with a small transaction. Deploy to GitHub Pages. For advanced setups, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. Deploy today. Own tomorrow.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack is designed for non-developers. Fork the template, customize the basics, and deploy. For advanced features, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step guides and templates.
What cryptocurrencies can customers use to pay?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT, BTC, ETH, and stablecoins on BSC, Solana, and TRON networks. Recommend low-fee networks like BSC or TRON for transactions under $0.10.
How do I handle refunds or chargebacks?

Crypto transactions are irreversible. Clearly state your refund policy on the store. For disputes, provide customer support via email or Telegram. The stack logs all transactions, so you can verify purchases easily.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?

No. This stack is designed for digital products with automated delivery. For physical goods, you’d need to integrate shipping APIs and manual order fulfillment, which is outside the scope of this architecture.
What happens if GitHub Pages or Cloudflare goes down?

GitHub Pages and Cloudflare have 99.9% uptime. If an outage occurs, your store remains in your repository. Redeploy to another provider like Netlify or Vercel. The stack is modular—no single point of failure.
You own the code, the data, and the deployment—sovereign infrastructure, not rented platforms.
Complete Builder Kit — $197. All 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. Everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Instant download. Worth $348 separately.
